question_en: Which places have been used as filming locations for the most movies?
question_fr: Quels lieux ont servi de décor de tournage au plus grand nombre de films ?
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_NAME, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_SOURCE, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.POSTER_PATH, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.WIKIPEDIA_IMAGE_PATH, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.OVERVIEW, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.MOVIE_COUNT, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.SERIE_COUNT, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.IMDB_RATING, COUNT(DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_MOVIE) AS FILM_COUNT FROM T_WC_T2S_LOCATION JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION WHERE T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.DELETED = 0 AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.LOCATION_ROLE = 'filming' GROUP BY T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_NAME, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_SOURCE, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.POSTER_PATH, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.WIKIPEDIA_IMAGE_PATH, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.OVERVIEW, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.MOVIE_COUNT, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.SERIE_COUNT, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.IMDB_RATING ORDER BY FILM_COUNT DESC LIMIT 50
